qa_pairs.question: What should be done to the upper tail panel connecting joint if applicable?
qa_pairs.answer: If applicable, tin the upper tail panel connecting joint.

qa_pairs.question: What is the important note about the spot welding flange in the rear area of the wheel housing opening?
qa_pairs.answer: The spot welding flange in the rear area of the wheel housing opening must be crimped on cars beginning with 1988 models or when using wider tires.

qa_pairs.question: What should you do if necessary when working on the wheel housing opening flange?
qa_pairs.answer: Compare with opposite side if necessary.

qa_pairs.question: What part number is shown in the diagram illustrating the wheel housing flange area?
How should all joints be sealed after body work?
qa_pairs.answer: Seal all joints with body sealing compound and spray with anti-drumming compound.

qa_pairs.question: What specific area should receive anti-drumming compound spray according to the bottom instruction?
qa_pairs.answer: Spray anti-drumming compound on the side panel/tail panel joint underneath the bumper.

qa_pairs.question: What part number corresponds to the image showing the side panel/tail panel joint area?
What part number is associated with the middle image showing joint sealing?
When is crimping of the spot welding flange required?
qa_pairs.answer: Crimping is required on cars beginning with 1988 models or when using wider tires.

qa_pairs.question: What two types of compounds are specified for joint treatment?
qa_pairs.answer: Body sealing compound and anti-drumming compound.
